# transcdr_event_destination (Resource)

An event destination (a webhook endpoint, `/v1/webhooks`): where Transcdr sends events such as `job.completed`. It targets an HTTPS URL (`url`), an Amazon SNS topic (`topic_arn` + `aws`) or an Amazon SQS queue (`queue_url` + `aws`), or names a messaging connection (`connection_id`) that holds the target and credentials. Needs a plan with the `webhooks` feature.

Every delivery is signed with `signing_secret`: HTTPS in the `Transcdr-Signature` header, SNS and SQS in the `transcdr-signature` message attribute.

`aws.secret_access_key` is write-only: Terraform keeps the configured value and sends it again only when it changes, which is how you rotate it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Signed POSTs to your server. Verify the Transcdr-Signature header with
# signing_secret before trusting a delivery.
resource "transcdr_event_destination" "https" {
  url         = "https://example.com/hooks/transcdr"
  events      = ["job.completed", "job.failed"] # or leave out for every event
  description = "Job outcomes"

  # Change this number to rotate signing_secret; the old secret stops working
  # at once.
  secret_version = 1
}

# Publish to an SNS topic, to fan out to Lambda, SQS, email and more. The
# signature is in the transcdr-signature message attribute.
resource "transcdr_event_destination" "sns" {
  topic_arn = aws_sns_topic.events.arn
  aws = {
    access_key_id     = aws_iam_access_key.transcdr.id     # needs sns:Publish on the topic
    secret_access_key = aws_iam_access_key.transcdr.secret # write-only; change it to rotate
  }
  events = ["job.completed"]
}

# Send to an SQS queue your workers consume. FIFO queues (.fifo) also accept
# aws.message_group_id.
resource "transcdr_event_destination" "sqs" {
  queue_url = aws_sqs_queue.events.url
  aws = {
    access_key_id     = aws_iam_access_key.transcdr.id # needs sqs:SendMessage on the queue
    secret_access_key = aws_iam_access_key.transcdr.secret
  }
}

# Deliver through a messaging connection (sqs, sns or webhook), which holds
# the target and its credentials. The connection's health and on/off state
# then apply to this destination too.
resource "transcdr_event_destination" "via_connection" {
  connection_id = transcdr_connection.triggers.id
  events        = ["*"]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `aws` (Attributes) `sns` and `sqs` targets: the credentials and settings to send with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `connection_id` (String) Deliver through an `sqs`, `sns` or `webhook` connection instead of a target of its own. The connection's health and `enabled` flag then apply. Changing it replaces the endpoint.
- `description` (String) A description, up to 500 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are sent. Default true.
- `events` (Set of String) The event types to send, or `["*"]` for all (the default): `job.created`, `job.scheduled`, `job.started`, `job.completed`, `job.failed`, `job.canceled`, `job.delivered`, `job.delivery_failed`, `asset.ready`, `asset.deleted`, `automation.triggered`, `connection.disabled`, `webhook.test`.
- `queue_url` (String) `sqs`: the queue URL (`.fifo` for FIFO queues). The key needs `sqs:SendMessage` on it.
- `secret_version` (Number) Any number. Changing it rotates `signing_secret`; the old secret stops working at once. Not sent to the API; setting it on create does not rotate.
- `topic_arn` (String) `sns`: the topic ARN (`.fifo` for FIFO topics). The key needs `sns:Publish` on it.
- `type` (String) `https`, `sns` or `sqs`. Read from the target (`url`, `topic_arn` or `queue_url`) or the connection's kind when omitted. It cannot change: a new type replaces the endpoint.
- `url` (String) `https`: the public https URL events are POSTed to.

### Read-Only

- `failure_count` (Number) Failed deliveries in a row.
- `id` (String) The endpoint id, `whk_…`.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) The `whsec_…` secret deliveries are signed with. Returned only when the endpoint is created or its secret rotated, so it is empty after an import until `secret_version` changes.
- `target` (String) Where events go: the HTTPS URL, topic ARN or queue URL, including a connection's.

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `access_key_id` (String) The access key ID.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The secret access key. Write-only: change it to rotate.

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) `sns` only: an SNS-compatible service endpoint instead of AWS's. (An SQS queue URL is its own endpoint.) Removing it replaces the endpoint, since the API cannot clear it.
- `message_group_id` (String) FIFO topics and queues: the message group (the API's default is `transcdr`). Removing it replaces the endpoint, since the API cannot clear it.
- `region` (String) Read from the topic ARN or queue URL when omitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An endpoint id, whk_... The API returns the signing secret only on create and
# rotate: change secret_version after an import to have one in state.
terraform import transcdr_event_destination.https whk_2Lk9Pz7Rt5Vw3Yb1N4Qm8x
```
